_description: Schema for community-submitted posts. Uses same structure as AI posts but with author: 'Community' tag. Stored in data/posts/ after approval.

submission.title: string (required, 5-200 chars)
submission.content: string (required, 100-5000 chars, markdown or plain text)
submission.tag: string (one of: Public Health|Pet Theft|Regulation|Public Support|Lucky's Story|Campaign Updates|Community)

_note: Approved posts are converted to standard blog post format in data/posts/ with author='Community' and tag='Community'
